paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : StableMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the validation performance of two routing policies—StableMoE and SimSMoE—over the course of training, as measured by the Bits Per Character (BPC) metric. The x-axis, labeled “Training Steps (×10³),” spans from 0 to 50,000 steps with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000 (i.e., 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50), and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BPC,” ranges from approximately 1.0 to 2.25, with major gridlines at 1.25, 1.50, 1.75, 2.00, and 2.25, also on a linear scale. The “StableMoE Validating” curve, shown in cyan with upward-pointing triangle markers and a solid line, begins at approximately 2.25 BPC at 0 training steps, drops sharply to around 1.50 BPC by 5,000 steps, and gradually declines further to stabilize near 1.15 BPC by 50,000 steps. The “SimSMoE Validating” curve, shown in magenta with circular markers and a solid line, starts slightly lower at approximately 2.20 BPC, follows a similar steep decline to about 1.45 BPC by 5,000 steps, and then converges closely with StableMoE, ending near 1.15 BPC at 50,000 steps. Both curves exhibit rapid initial improvement followed by slower, steady convergence toward a similar low BPC value, with SimSMoE consistently slightly outperforming StableMoE after ~10,000 steps.
